entries.title: II Corinthians 11:1
segments: I would that you were bearing with me a little in foolishness; but indeed bear with me.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:2
segments: For I am jealous [over] you with godly jealousy. For I have espoused you to one Man, to present [you as] a pure virgin to Christ.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:3
segments: But I fear lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve in his craftiness, so your thoughts should be corrupted from the simplicity due to Christ.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:4
segments: For if, indeed, the [one] coming proclaims another Jesus, whom we have not proclaimed, or [if] you receive another spirit, which you did not receive, or another gospel, which you never accepted, you might well endure [these].

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:5
segments: For I judge [myself] to have come behind the highest apostles [in] nothing.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:6
segments: But even if [I am] unskilled in speech, yet not in knowledge; but in every way [I] have been clearly revealed to you in all things.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:7
segments: Or did I commit sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached the gospel of God to you without charge?

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:8
segments: I stripped other churches, taking wages for the serving of you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:9
segments: And being present with you, and in need, I was not a burden to anyone. For the brothers from Macedonia made up completely my need. And in every way I have kept myself from being burdensome [to you], and I will keep myself.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:10
segments: The truth of Christ is in me that this boasting shall not be silenced in me in the regions of Achaia.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:11
segments: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:12
segments: But what I do, that I will do, so that I may cut off occasion from those who desire occasion; so that in the thing in which they boast, they may be found even as we.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:13
segments: For such ones [are] false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:14
segments: Did not even Satan marvelously transform himself into an angel of light?

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:15
segments: Therefore [it is] no great thing if his ministers also transform themselves as ministers of righteousness, whose end shall be according to their works.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:16
segments: Again I say, Let no one think me foolish. If otherwise, yet receive me as foolish, so that I may also boast a little.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:17
segments: What I speak, I do not speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this boldness of boasting.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:18
segments: Since many glory according to the flesh, I also will boast.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:19
segments: For you gladly bear with fools, being wise.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:20
segments: For you endure if anyone enslaves you, if anyone devours, if anyone takes [from you], if anyone exalts himself, if anyone strikes you in the face.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:21
segments: I speak according to dishonor, as though we have been weak. But in whatever anyone dares (I speak foolishly), I also dare.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:22
segments: Are they Hebrews? I also! Are they Israelites? I also! Are they the seed of Abraham? I also!

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:23
segments: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as beside myself,) I [am] more! [I have been] in labors more abundantly, in stripes above measure, in prisons more, in deaths many times.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:24
segments: Five times from the Jews I received forty [stripes] minus one.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:25
segments: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked. I have spent a night and a day in the deep.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:26
segments: I have been in travels often; in dangers from waters; in dangers from robbers; in dangers from [my] race; in dangers from [the] heathen; in dangers in [the] city; in dangers in [the] wilderness; in dangers on [the]  sea; in dangers among false brothers.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:27
segments: [I have been] in hardship and toil; often in watchings; in hunger and thirst; often in fastings; in cold and nakedness;

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:28
segments: besides the things outside conspiring against me daily, the care of all the churches.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:29
segments: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I do not burn?

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:30
segments: If it is right to boast, I will boast, I will boast [of] the things of my weakness.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:31
segments: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who is blessed forever, knows that I do not lie.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:32
segments: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king guarded the city of [the] Damascenes, desiring to lay hold of me.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:33
segments: And I was let down in a basket through a window through the wall, and escaped their hands.
